[EN] Basilisks are such fine creatures! They're just amazing. If only they weren't deadly, I would keep one as a pet!

Actually, I wonder...if I got one of those eggs and raised it from a baby, do you think it would love me?
[ES] ¡Los basiliscos son criaturas tan bellas! Son simplemente asombrosos. Si tan solo no fueran mortales, ¡tendría uno como mascota!

En realidad, me pregunto... si consiguiera uno de esos huevos y lo criara desde bebé, ¿crees que me querría?
